identity_note: Matched the Atlanta-based, Compass Group Equity Partners-backed interventional pain-management MSO. The batch website resolvepainsolutions.com does not resolve (DNS failure); every press release (PR Newswire, Jan and Mar 2026) gives the company's site as resolve-pain.com. Sector (medical, pain management) and HQ (Atlanta) match the batch entry. No other company of this name surfaced.

profile.name: Resolve Pain Solutions
profile.description: Management services organization that partners with and acquires interventional pain-management practices across the Southeast, taking over billing, marketing, finance and HR so physicians can focus on patients.
profile.location: Atlanta, GA (HQ); practices in GA, TN, MS, AL, LA and SC
profile.year_founded: 2022 (Compass Group launched the platform Sep 2022 around the Memphis practice Mays & Schnapp; Simplify lists 2023; CB Insights' 1985 is the founding year of Mays & Schnapp, not the MSO)
profile.founder: No individual founder named. Platform formed by Compass Group Equity Partners (Sep 2022) anchored on Mays & Schnapp (founded 1985 by Dr. Kit S. Mays and Dr. Moacir Schnapp). Eric Schnapp was CEO as of 2024; Andrew Jones is CEO as of Jan-Mar 2026 press releases.
profile.funding_detail: PE-backed: portfolio company of Compass Group Equity Partners since 2022. Recapitalized in Dec 2024 with debt financing agented by TPG Twin Brook, which also funded the Louisiana Pain Specialists add-on. Deal sizes undisclosed.
profile.headcount: Sources disagree: Built In lists 125 employees; Simplify lists 11-50 (likely MSO corporate staff only, excluding affiliated practices)
profile.past_completed_deals: Southcoast Spine and Pain, Aiken SC (Mar 2026); Spine Diagnostic & Pain Treatment Center, Baton Rouge LA (Jan 2026); Louisiana Pain Specialists, 7 clinics, LA (2024); Alabama Anesthesiology & Pain Consultants, 4 AL locations (Feb 2024 per company press listing); Advanced Pain Management, Evans/Augusta GA (before Feb 2024, date unconfirmed); Mays & Schnapp Neurospine and Pain, Memphis TN/MS (anchor investment, Sep 2022)
profile.open_role: Careers page blocked (SiteGround captcha, HTTP 202) as of 2026-10-08; Built In lists 3 roles (Manager, Strategic Initiatives & Market Development; Manager, Provider Recruitment and Engagement; Front Desk Receptionist), not confirmed on the live careers page
profile.contact_path: https://www.resolve-pain.com/why-partner/ (practice-partnership page; site behind captcha); media: Josh Rebuck, Director of Marketing, (706) 536-6165 per PR Newswire

caveats: Website: batch URL resolvepainsolutions.com does not resolve; used resolve-pain.com from the press releases
Careers page: resolve-pain.com sits behind a SiteGround captcha, so no live careers read; roles come from Built In
Headlines: latest news is the Mar 9 2026 Southcoast deal, outside the 6-month window; nothing newer found
Founded: Simplify says 2023, CB Insights says 1985 (Mays & Schnapp); used the Sep 2022 Compass platform launch
CEO change: Becker's 2024 named Eric Schnapp CEO; 2026 releases name Andrew Jones; transition date not found
Headcount: Built In says 125, Simplify says 11-50
Deal dates: Alabama (Feb 2024) and Advanced Pain Management dates come from search-index snippets of company pages behind a captcha
Caleb Wilson: title from a company press page title and Datanyze; the page itself could not be opened
Founder LinkedIn/email: no individual founder and no LinkedIn URL verified; left null
